data.name: Partho
data.gender_notes: Partho is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word Partha, meaning 'lover of horses'. It is associated with the god Arjuna from the Hindu epic Mahabharata. The name is believed to symbolize courage, strength, and victory. The name Partho carries the meaning “Lover of Horses” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Partho usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine horse, Eka-Eshvara, which is considered the vehicle of Lord Vishnu. Partho is believed to invoke the power and strength of the divine horse, providing courage and success in life.
data.etymology: Partho belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of Horses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Partho total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

The name carries forward this admiration and association with regal and powerful symbols.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Partho is linked to Arjuna, one of the greatest warriors and heroic figures in Hindu mythology. Arjuna, a devoted student of the divine teacher, Lord Krishna, represents courage, selfless action, and unwavering devotion. The name Partho thus evokes a sense of bravery, spiritual seeker, and one striving for self-realization and personal growth.
